item.title: EiskaltDC++ 3.0.0-pre.2
item.description:
# EiskaltDC++ 3.0.0-pre.2
Translation-completion preview of the integrated Direct Connect and BitTorrent client.
## Changes
- Completed all 19,006 outstanding catalog entries across the Qt interface, DC++ core, and legacy GTK interface. This includes 972 explicit English source-language entries in the GTK catalog. All 25 Qt language catalogs now have zero unfinished entries. - Corrected upload-recipient wording and small label/keyboard-accelerator issues found during cross-review. - Added complete-catalog checks, including fuzzy and incomplete gettext plurals, and verified roundtrips for all 52,150 active Qt messages. - Screened 480 settings views in the seven newly completed GUI languages and English at two widths and two palettes. No clipping candidates were detected in the tested labels, checkboxes and radio buttons. This is static screening, not native-speaker certification or complete native UI acceptance.
Runtime C++ implementation remains the same as pre.1; this release incorporates completed translation resources and documentation/verification updates.
## Downloads
- Intel x86_64 only: macOS 14 or newer. - Apple Silicon arm64 only: macOS 26 or newer.
Both include the native updater. Internal macOS build **30000002** orders this release after pre.1/build 30000001. Updates are staged and installed only after an explicitly committed normal quit.
## Signing And Test Limits
These apps are **ad-hoc signed, not Developer ID signed or notarized**. Sparkle archives and feeds are separately authenticated with the pinned update key. macOS may require approval before first launch.
Both CPUs passed five disposable full-application updater/quit scenarios, including canceled quit and forced precommit exit. Actual bundled Cocoa startup and dependency-closure checks passed on macOS 27; Intel execution used Rosetta. Advertised minimum OS versions are checked in every bundled Mach-O image, but native macOS 14/26 and physical Intel acceptance remain unverified.
Native-speaker review, broader Windows/Linux QA and whole-archive dependency reproducibility remain future work. Project and matching dependency sources, notices and SHA-256 hashes accompany the release.
